status: frozen before inspecting forward-return evaluation; retrospective exploratory study
purpose: Test whether detector pattern indicators or saved JEV pattern probabilities improve five-session directional forecasts beyond visible numeric OHLCV.
cohort: Only the 1200 canonical 06a market candles with complete v7 definitions predictions; synthetic and 06b showcase rows excluded.
sampling_caveat: Cohort selected for balanced pattern recognition (75/class/split), not natural market frequencies; retrospective surviving ticker universe.
jev_arm: definitions_p1, chosen after reviewing recognition scores, before inspecting these forward-return outcomes

target.sigma: Sample std (ddof=1) of 60 overlapping trailing five-session adjusted-close returns, including the chart end; needs 65 closes.
target.flat_rule: Flat iff abs(forward_return) < flat_band * trailing_sigma; boundary ties are directional.
target.return: Adjusted close[t+5]/adjusted close[t]-1; after-close forecast convention, not executable entry or net trading P&L.

features.A: 160 existing Exp06 normalized OHLCV grid features plus the eight visible-window summaries below
features.B: A plus 8 one-hot detector labels; causal TA-Lib and pandas detectors must both reproduce the canonical index label.
features.C: A plus the 8 saved JEV definitions pattern probabilities in declared option order; these are pattern probabilities, not direct return forecasts.
features.forbidden: No ticker/date/file/split/clarity metadata or forward-return/target-volatility scale enters feature matrices.

model.training: Fit each scaler and model only on its training rows; checkpoint reload prediction diff <= 1e-12

primary_evaluation.name: fixed_holdout
primary_evaluation.purge: Every training target must precede the earliest test information_start (65-close target-scale history and 20-bar feature window).

secondary_evaluation.name: annual_walkforward
secondary_evaluation.training: Expanding through prior years of this recorded cohort, including earlier test years once historical. No within-year fitting.
secondary_evaluation.purge: Training chart end before January 1 of the test year AND target_date before the earliest test information_start.

eligibility: Exclude insufficient 65-close history, nonpositive trailing sigma, missing five-session target, and original train rows whose target crosses 2018-12-31; identical rows for every arm. Invalid inputs fail, never silently drop.
primary_comparison: C_jev minus A_numeric predictive value, measured as A Brier loss minus C Brier loss.
primary_metric: Paired multiclass Brier loss reduction; sum over the three return classes

uncertainty.cluster: Calendar forecast week ending Friday, all dates/tickers in each week together
uncertainty.method: Circular moving blocks of consecutive retained calendar-week clusters, row weighted. Sparse gaps can span more calendar weeks. Fixed predictions, no refitting in bootstrap.
uncertainty.limitations: Approximate stationarity; sparse pattern-selected cohort, overlapping targets, finite retrospective sample; no multiplicity correction or independent confirmation.

continuation_rule: Primary fixed-holdout C-vs-A four-retained-week Brier CI strictly above zero, C point Brier below the training prior, AND secondary annual-walkforward pooled C-vs-A Brier improvement positive. Otherwise no demonstrated case for further JEV compute from this study.
interpretation: Named-pattern failure alone does not rule out useful information in the full JEV probability vector. No forecasting or trading claim follows from recognition accuracy.
prospective_policy: Does not alter Exp05's frozen prospective protocol/models or evaluate its future holdout. Any positive finding needs independently collected future validation.

execution.dependencies: Existing pinned 06-jev-patterns/.venv and requirements.txt; no new dependencies.
